methodologyNotes: Seed list corrected/expanded after verification. 'Nova Star Knee Walker' does not exist as a distinct product from NOVA Medical Products (parent site novajoy.com/novamedicalproducts.com show a 'Star' rollator/Star DX line and a separate 'Knee Walker' line, model TKW-12) — corrected to NOVA Knee Walker TKW-12. 'Goodwheel All-Terrain' and 'Wheelable Compact' brands could not be found under any spelling on manufacturer sites, retailer catalogs, or product indexes and were dropped rather than guessed; replaced with two real, verifiable all-terrain/compact competitors buyers actually compare: Zipr Pathfinder Knee Walker (Zip'r Mobility) and KneeRover GO (KneeRover's compact folding line, used in place of the unconfirmed 'KneeRover Economy' naming — KneeRover's own site groups this tier under GO/Ultra). ELENKER Deluxe Knee Walker (YF-9002A/YF-9003C) was researched and specs were located (300 lb capacity, 8 in PVC wheels, dual hand + rear brakes, ~23 lb, ~$80-170 street price) but the manufacturer site (elenkerwalker.com) returned persistent HTTP 429 rate-limiting across many retry attempts and every alternate retailer checked (Walmart, eBay, Tedonic, Amazon, manuals.plus) was unreachable or CAPTCHA-blocked during this research session, so it was left out of the dataset rather than sourced from an unverified secondary synthesis. Drive Medical is represented by three real, distinct SKUs the brand actually sells (DV8 standard steerable model 790, Economy Folding Knee Walker RTL799, and 990X All-Terrain), mirroring how the brand is actually presented to buyers. Specs were pulled directly from manufacturer sites where reachable (tkwcinc.com for Swivelmate, shop.drivemedical.com for the Economy model, vevor.fr for VEVOR — vevor.com auto-redirected to the .fr storefront for this session's network egress, so VEVOR pricing is EUR-only and priceUsd is left null rather than converted/guessed) and from authorized-dealer product pages when the manufacturer's own page blocked automated access (mnmobilitysupply.com, shop.baronmedical.com, cvimedical.com, rehabmart.com, ritewaymed.com, allstarmedicalllc.com, home-med-equip.com, allterrainmedical.com — all independent DME retailers republishing manufacturer spec sheets, not marketplaces with user-generated listings). priceUsd = the retailer/manufacturer's current advertised starting price in USD at access time; sale prices are used where no separate MSRP is published, and noted in priceNote. weight_capacity_lb and weight_lb are manufacturer-stated. wheel_size_in reflects the wheel diameter used in the product's own marketing copy; left null where the only located figures were ambiguous caster-width numbers rather than diameter. all_terrain = true only for models explicitly marketed as all-terrain/off-road (typically 12 in pneumatic or rugged tires), false for standard 7-8 in indoor/outdoor models. Every image is a real product photo pulled directly from the sourced manufacturer or authorized-dealer page (verified byte-for-byte as valid JPEG/WebP after fetch); the 'image' key is omitted entirely (not null) for the 3 products (KneeRover GO, Drive Medical Economy RTL799, Drive Medical 990X) where no usable image URL could be located in the fetched page markup. No Wikimedia Commons image in the 'Knee scooters' category depicts any of the 13 branded products in this dataset (they show a generic/unbranded Essential Medical Supply device and vector icons), so none were used to avoid misattributing a photo to the wrong brand. All sources accessed 2026-08-01. A null beats any guess.
